translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Market structure uses CONFIRMED fractal pivots: swing_high(k)/swing_low(k) become known only k bars after the pivot, so no future swing point is used. swing_*(k, j) is the j-th most recent pivot; swing_*_age gives bars since that pivot (used to order points and project trend lines).

strategies.name: Bullish Engulfing at Support
strategies.entry: close[1] < open[1] and close > open and close >= open[1] and open <= close[1] and abs(low - sma(close, 50)) <= $tol * sma(close, 50)
assumptions: 'near SMA(50)' = the low within tol of SMA50

strategies.name: Bearish Engulfing at Resistance
strategies.entry: close[1] > open[1] and close < open and open >= close[1] and close <= open[1]

strategies.name: Hammer / Bullish Pin Bar
strategies.entry: (min(open, close) - low) > 2 * abs(close - open) and (high - max(open, close)) < 0.2 * (high - low)

strategies.name: Shooting Star / Bearish Pin Bar
strategies.entry: (high - max(open, close)) > 2 * abs(close - open) and (min(open, close) - low) < 0.2 * (high - low)

strategies.name: Morning Star
strategies.entry: close[2] < open[2] and abs(close[1] - open[1]) < 0.3 * (high[1] - low[1]) and close > open and close > (open[2] + close[2]) / 2

strategies.name: Evening Star
strategies.entry: close[2] > open[2] and abs(close[1] - open[1]) < 0.3 * (high[1] - low[1]) and close < open and close < (open[2] + close[2]) / 2

strategies.name: Piercing Line
strategies.entry: open < low[1] and close > (open[1] + close[1]) / 2
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation added close[1] < open[1] (red prior candle, from the prose); the original formula has no colour condition

strategies.name: Dark Cloud Cover
strategies.entry: open > high[1] and close < (open[1] + close[1]) / 2
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation added close[1] > open[1] (green prior candle, from the prose); the original formula has no colour condition

strategies.name: Three White Soldiers
strategies.entry: all_of(close > open, 3) and open > min(open[1], close[1]) and open < max(open[1], close[1]) and open[1] > min(open[2], close[2]) and open[1] < max(open[2], close[2]) and close > high[1] and close[1] > high[2]

strategies.name: Three Black Crows
strategies.entry: all_of(close < open, 3) and close < low[1] and close[1] < low[2]

strategies.name: Bullish Marubozu
strategies.entry: close > open and (high - close) / (high - low) < 0.05 and (open - low) / (high - low) < 0.05

strategies.name: Bullish Harami Cross
strategies.entry: close[2] < open[2] and (high[2] - low[2]) > atr(14)[2] and abs(close[1] - open[1]) < 0.1 * (high[1] - low[1]) and max(open[1], close[1]) < open[2] and min(open[1], close[1]) > close[2] and close > high[2]
assumptions: 'wide' = range above ATR(14); doji = body < 10% of range; trigger = close above Bar1 high

strategies.name: Bullish Kicker
strategies.entry: close[1] < open[1] and open > open[1] and close > open

strategies.name: Rising Three Methods
strategies.entry: close[4] > open[4] and highest(high, 3)[1] < high[4] and lowest(low, 3)[1] > low[4] and close > high[4]

strategies.name: Tweezer Bottom
strategies.entry: abs(low - low[1]) / low < 0.001 and close > open

strategies.name: Dragonfly Doji at Demand Zone
strategies.entry: abs(close - open) < 0.1 * (high - low) and (high - max(open, close)) < 0.1 * (high - low)
assumptions: the demand-zone qualifier is not defined in the catalogue and is not applied

strategies.name: Break of Structure (Bullish)
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))

strategies.name: Change of Character (Bullish)
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))

strategies.name: Fair Value Gap Tap
strategies.entry: low[2] > high[4] and low <= low[2] and low >= high[4]
assumptions: literal catalogue indices: gap between High[t-4] and Low[t-2], tapped by Low[t]

strategies.name: Bullish Order Block Mitigation
strategies.entry: barssince(cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) >= 1 and barssince(cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) <= 20 and low <= valuewhen(cross_above(close, swing_high(3)), valuewhen(close < open, high)[1]) and close > valuewhen(cross_above(close, swing_high(3)), valuewhen(close < open, low)[1]) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: BOS = close crossing the last confirmed swing high; order block = the last red candle before the BOS bar; retest within 20 bars with a volume spike

strategies.name: Liquidity Sweep / Turtle Soup
strategies.entry: low < lowest(low, 20)[1] and close > lowest(low, 20)[1] and close > open

strategies.name: Equal Highs Liquidity Magnet Breakout
strategies.entry: abs(swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / swing_high(3) < 0.005 and abs(swing_high(3, 2) - swing_high(3, 3)) / swing_high(3) < 0.005 and close > max(swing_high(3), swing_high(3, 2), swing_high(3, 3)) and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Support-Turned-Resistance Flip
strategies.entry: any_of(close > highest(high, 20)[1], 4)[2] and low <= valuewhen(close > highest(high, 20)[1], highest(high, 20)[1]) * 1.01 and close > valuewhen(close > highest(high, 20)[1], highest(high, 20)[1]) and close > open
assumptions: Resistance_Zone = the 20-bar high broken between t-5 and t-2; touch = low within 1% above it

strategies.name: Higher High, Higher Low (Dow)
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2)

strategies.name: Cup and Handle Breakout
strategies.entry: between((highest(high, 120)[20] - lowest(low, 100)[20]) / highest(high, 120)[20], 0.15, 0.35) and (highest(high, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) / highest(high, 20) < 0.12 and lowest(low, 20) > (highest(high, 120)[20] + lowest(low, 100)[20]) / 2 and close > highest(high, 20)[1]
assumptions: cup = the 120 bars before the last 20 (depth 15-35%); handle = last 20 bars, depth < 12%, in the cup's upper half; roundness not tested

strategies.name: Double Bottom Neckline Breakout
strategies.entry: abs(swing_low(5) - swing_low(5, 2)) / swing_low(5, 2) < 0.02 and swing_high_age(5) < swing_low_age(5, 2) and swing_high_age(5) > swing_low_age(5) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5))

strategies.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_low(5, 2) < swing_low(5, 3) and swing_low(5) > swing_low(5, 2) and cross_above(close, max(swing_high(5), swing_high(5, 2)))
assumptions: neckline = horizontal at the higher of the two most recent swing highs

strategies.name: Ascending Triangle Breakout
strategies.entry: abs(swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / swing_high(3) < 0.01 and abs(swing_high(3, 2) - swing_high(3, 3)) / swing_high(3) < 0.01 and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and close > max(swing_high(3), swing_high(3, 2), swing_high(3, 3))

strategies.name: Symmetrical Triangle Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and close > swing_high(3) + (swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / (swing_high_age(3, 2) - swing_high_age(3)) * swing_high_age(3) and volume > sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: upper trendline projected through the two most recent swing highs to the current bar

strategies.name: Falling Wedge Bullish Reversal
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and (swing_high(3, 2) - swing_low(3, 2)) > (swing_high(3) - swing_low(3)) and close > swing_high(3) + (swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / (swing_high_age(3, 2) - swing_high_age(3)) * swing_high_age(3)
assumptions: converging = the latest high-low swing span narrower than the previous one; breakout above the projected upper line

strategies.name: Bull Flag / Pennant Continuation
strategies.entry: roc(close, 8)[5] > $pole and (highest(high, 6) - lowest(low, 5)) < 0.382 * (highest(high, 6) - low[13]) and sma(volume, 5) < sma(volume, 20) and close > highest(high, 5)[1]
assumptions: pole = 8-bar gain ending 5 bars ago; flag retracement < 38.2% of the pole; low flag volume; breakout above the 5-bar flag high

strategies.name: Rectangle / Darvas Range Breakout
strategies.entry: (highest(high, 20)[1] - lowest(low, 20)[1]) / lowest(low, 20)[1] < 0.12 and close > highest(high, 20)[1]

strategies.name: Rounding Bottom (Saucer)
strategies.entry: slope(close, 30)[30] < 0 and slope(close, 30) > 0 and slope(close, 30) > slope(close, 30)[15] and slope(close, 30)[15] > slope(close, 30)[30] and close > highest(high, 60)[1]
assumptions: positive curvature (a > 0) approximated by a monotonically rising 30-bar regression slope from negative to positive over 60 bars

strategies.name: Measured Move (ABCD)
strategies.entry: swing_low_age(5) < swing_high_age(5) and swing_high_age(5) < swing_low_age(5, 2) and swing_low(5) <= swing_high(5) - 0.382 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5, 2)) and swing_low(5) >= swing_high(5) - 0.618 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5, 2)) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5))
assumptions: A = previous swing low, B = swing high, C = latest swing low retracing 38.2-61.8% of AB; trigger close above B

blocked.reason: needs a harmonic-ratio matcher across three drives plus RSI read at variable pivot offsets (the DSL lag must be constant)

strategies.name: Gartley 222
strategies.entry: harmonic("gartley", $k, 0.05) > 0 and close > open
assumptions: XABCD from the five latest confirmed alternating pivots (M6.2 harmonic primitive, 5% ratio tolerance); bullish reversal candle = close > open on the bar the D pivot is known

strategies.name: Bat Harmonic Pattern
strategies.entry: harmonic("bat", $k, 0.05) > 0 and rsi(close, 14) < 30
assumptions: Bat ratios (AB 0.382-0.5 XA, AD 0.886 XA) on confirmed pivots; D is known k bars after the pivot, so RSI is read at confirmation

strategies.name: Fibonacci Golden Pocket Pullback
strategies.entry: swing_low_age(5) > swing_high_age(5) and low <= swing_high(5) - 0.618 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and low >= swing_high(5) - 0.65 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and close > swing_high(5) - 0.618 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5))
assumptions: impulse leg = last confirmed swing low followed by the last confirmed swing high

strategies.name: Fibonacci 38.2% Power Trend Pullback
strategies.entry: adx(14) > 30 and swing_low_age(5) > swing_high_age(5) and low <= swing_high(5) - 0.382 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and close > swing_high(5) - 0.382 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and close > open

strategies.name: Fibonacci Extension Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_low_age(5) > swing_high_age(5) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5))
assumptions: entry when price clears 100% of the prior swing; the 1.272/1.618 extensions are targets, approximated by the breakout exit profile

blocked.reason: needs a 3-pivot pitchfork construction (median line from pivot 1 to the midpoint of pivots 2-3, with parallel tines)

strategies.name: Trendline 3rd Touch Bounce
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and abs(low - (swing_low(3) + (swing_low(3) - swing_low(3, 2)) / (swing_low_age(3, 2) - swing_low_age(3)) * swing_low_age(3))) <= 0.005 * low and close > open
assumptions: rising line through the last two confirmed swing lows, projected to the current bar; touch tolerance 0.5%

strategies.name: Downward Trendline Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_high(5) < swing_high(5, 2) and swing_high(5, 2) < swing_high(5, 3) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5) + (swing_high(5) - swing_high(5, 2)) / (swing_high_age(5, 2) - swing_high_age(5)) * swing_high_age(5)) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: descending line through LH1 and LH2 (with LH3 confirming the sequence), projected to the current bar

strategies.name: Broadening Formation Lower Boundary Bounce
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and low <= swing_low(3) * 1.01 and (min(open, close) - low) > 2 * abs(close - open)
assumptions: lower boundary approximated by the latest (lower) swing low; hammer = lower wick > 2 x body

strategies.name: Quasimodo (Over and Under) Reversal
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_high_age(3) < swing_low_age(3) and low <= swing_low(3, 2) * 1.005 and close > swing_low(3, 2)
assumptions: bullish QM: lower low then higher high (the high is the more recent pivot), entry on a retest of the left-shoulder low

strategies.name: 1-2-3 Trend Reversal (Sperandeo)
strategies.entry: sma(close, 50) < sma(close, 50)[20] and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and swing_low_age(3) < swing_high_age(3) and swing_high_age(3) < swing_low_age(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))
assumptions: prior downtrend = SMA50 falling over 20 bars; point 1 = low, bounce peak, point 2 = higher low, trigger close above the peak

strategies.name: 2B Reversal Rule
strategies.entry: low < swing_low(5) and close > swing_low(5)

strategies.name: Ross Hook
strategies.entry: barssince(swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) <= 10 and any_of(close < close[1], 2)[1] and close > highest(high, 3)[1]
assumptions: 1-2-3 breakout within the last 10 bars, a 1-2 bar pullback, then close above the 3-bar hook high

blocked.reason: needs a 5-point wedge matcher with the 1-3 line projection and wave-symmetry checks

strategies.name: Point & Figure Double/Triple Top Breakout
strategies.entry: pnf_breakout($box, 3, $cols)
assumptions: percentage boxes on the bar high/low path (one bar can move the column once); 3-box reversal; breakout = rising X column one box above the highest of the previous 2 (double) or 3 (triple) X-column tops
